subject: FinHealth DPA: redlines, HIPAA/SCC clarifications, and signature routing
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finhealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Darren Cole <darren.cole@finhealth.com>, contracts@finhealth.com, Sarah Parker <sarah.parker@wilkinsonlaw.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: FinHealth DPA redline and HIPAA/SCC questions

Hi Stephanie / Marissa —

Thanks again for the great demo last week. Attached is our initial redline of Redwood's standard DPA (FinHealth_DPA_v1_redline.pdf). A few quick asks up front:

- We flagged the retention clause (Sec 4.3) — we need confirmation Redwood can support a 7-year retention carve-out for certain regulated records and the ability to export on request.
- HIPAA: we added a request for Business Associate Agreement-style indemnity language (see markup). Can you confirm Redwood's stance?
- SCCs: we noted a request to include the EU SCCs template referencing subprocessors; also want an assurance about data residency controls for EU patients.

We would like to align and get to a signature-ready version by the end of next week if possible. I'm copying our procurement lead Darren and external counsel Sarah Parker.

Attachments: FinHealth_DPA_v1_redline.pdf

Best,
Elena
Director of Procurement, FinHealth
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Parker <sarah.parker@wilkinsonlaw.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth DPA redline and HIPAA/SCC questions

Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear redline. We're aligned on a tight timeline and will prioritize. Quick plan from our side:

1) I asked our legal ops and privacy team to review the retention and indemnity asks — looping in Marissa and Neha (cc).
2) Karthik, can you put together a draft SCCs matrix for subprocessors and residency controls? I started one and attached a working file: HIPAA_SCCs_matrix.xlsx.
3) Marissa / Neha: if possible please call out any redlines that are blockers vs tags we can accept.

Target: final DPA for signature by 2026-11-25. If that slips we'll propose a short amendment path to keep the deal moving.

Steph
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: HIPAA_SCCs_matrix.xlsx
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth DPA redline and HIPAA/SCC questions

Team — I reviewed Elena's redline and prioritized comments below. I attached a curated evidence bundle (SOC2_evidence_bundle.zip) to help with the security assurances.

Summary:
- Retention clause (Sec 4.3): FinHealth's 7-year ask is larger than our standard 18-month retention for logs; we can accept a 7-year "regulated records" carve-out provided we limit scope to agreed record types and require a formal Data Subject Export + Delete runbook.
- HIPAA indemnity: we cannot accept unlimited indemnity. Propose capped liability tied to fees for the DPA term and carve out gross negligence — we have proposed language in the attached redline.
- SCCs / subprocessors: Karthik, the SCCs matrix Steph created looks good — please lock down subprocessors list and confirm DOCS for EU residency.

If legal accepts the 7-year carve-out with scoped record types, I recommend we move to execute via DocuSign and route to FinHealth procurement + our Finance lead Laura for signature approval.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_evidence_bundle.zip
From: Sarah Parker <sarah.parker@wilkinsonlaw.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finhealth.com>, Darren Cole <darren.cole@finhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth DPA redline and HIPAA/SCC questions

Marissa / Steph — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOC2 bundle. On behalf of FinHealth we are generally comfortable with Redwood's proposed compromise but would like the following clarified before we sign:

- The 7-year carve-out: FinHealth will accept the scoped carve-out if Redwood provides a short appendix listing the exact data elements considered "regulated records" and an SLA for export requests (7 business days).
- Indemnity cap: FinHealth prefers a higher cap for HIPAA-specific breaches. Can Redwood confirm whether you can increase the HIPAA-related cap to 2x annual committed fees for the first year?
- Residency: we need confirmation that EU patient data can be pinned to eu-central-1 for processing and that subprocessors in the US will not receive raw identifiable EU patient data unless redacted.

Quoted for context:
On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 09:18 AM marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — I reviewed Elena's redline and prioritized comments below. I attached a curated evidence bundle (SOC2_evidence_bundle.zip) to help with the security assurances.

We can accept most redlines if Redwood agrees to the appendix and export SLA. Happy to discuss on a quick call.

Best,
Sarah Parker
Wilkinson & Co. (Counsel for FinHealth)
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth DPA redline and HIPAA/SCC questions

Quick internal direction: we should accept the appendix approach for the 7-year carve-out. Requirements for the appendix: exact field names, retention triggers, and export SLA (7 business days) — we can own the runbook.

On indemnity cap: we can agree to a HIPAA-specific uplift to 2x annual committed fees for year one but require that language sunsets after 12 months unless renewed in writing. That is our negotiable sweet spot.

Karthik: please finalize the SCCs matrix and produce the short appendix for regulated records.
Laura: please prep the signature routing — we'll need Finance sign-off for the concession.

Neha
Head of Privacy, Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finhealth.com>, Sarah Parker <sarah.parker@wilkinsonlaw.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Darren Cole <darren.cole@finhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: FinHealth DPA — final for signature and DocuSign routing

Elena / Sarah — thanks for the collaborative review. Per the thread above we've agreed internally to:

- Scoped 7-year carve-out for regulated records (appendix attached) with a 7-business-day export SLA.
- HIPAA indemnity cap increased to 2x annual committed fees for year one and sunsets at 12 months; language added to Sec 9.2.
- EU residency: we will pin EU patient processing to eu-central-1 and ensure subprocessors do not receive raw identifiable EU patient data unless redaction is explicitly allowed in writing.

I've attached the finalized PDF (FinHealth_DPA_final_for_signature.pdf) and created a DocuSign envelope for signatures: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ12345. Please confirm receipt and we'll aim for signatures within 72 hours to keep the onboarding date.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm the appendix fields are acceptable (attached).
- Sarah: once confirmed we will send DocuSign to FinHealth signatories and route to our Finance (Laura) for countersignature.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if needed.

Steph
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: FinHealth_DPA_final_for_signature.pdf
